mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest way to start AI workflow automation when I have almost no budget?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A limited budget favors a small, measurable workflow using tools you already understand, rather than a large multi-agent build. Start with an educational or low-risk task such as research summaries, newsletter drafting, content repurposing, or organizing prospects.

## Context
Run My AI Business offers a free starting option and lists a $9 monthly paid newsletter, while the operational costs of external AI, automation, email, hosting, sales, and storage tools vary separately. The newsletter can help readers compare options before spending more.

## Key factors
- Existing subscriptions and integrations
- Volume of work
- Cost of manual effort
- Ability to measure a useful outcome

## Practical guidance
Write a monthly tool budget and choose one success metric. Use free tiers or trials only after checking limits, data handling, export options, and whether the workflow can be moved if the service no longer fits.

A low-cost pilot is more informative than buying a large bundle in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with one low-risk workflow and tools you already use or can test at low cost. Run My AI Business lists a free starting option and a $9 monthly newsletter, but separate AI and automation tools may add costs. Track one measurable result before expanding.
